title: Treaty of the Eighteen Articles
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of the Eighteen Articles", at revision 1304154617, opens: "The Treaty of the Eighteen Articles was a proposal for a treaty between Belgium and the Netherlands to establish borders between the two countries." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3536945, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1831 proposed treaty between Belgium and the Netherlands". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
